reliquary-of-dawn.summary: A talisman holding a shed claw, scale or fang of Eirdu, the sun of Lorwyn; wearing it makes you immune to Eventide's effects.

reliquary-of-twilight.summary: A talisman holding a shed claw, scale or fang of Isilu, the moon of Shadowmoor; wearing it makes you immune to Morningtide's effects.
